d:
Lok aastha ka mahaparv chhath char dinon tak chalne vali kathin sadhna, shuddhata aur sury upasna ka parv hai. is dauran vrati puri shraddha aur niyam ke sath bhagvan sury aur chhathi maiya ki aaradhna karte hain. chhath ki shuruaat nahay-khay se hoti hai aur chauthe din ugte sury ko arghy dene ke bad paran ke sath iska samapan hota hai.
